summary: A two-panel horizontal group (Files 25%, Editor 75%) in a bordered frame with a caption showing the live percentages.
use: Split views where the user sizes a side panel: file trees, inspectors, mail readers.
spec: `<ResizablePanel id="files" defaultSize={25} minSize={15} maxSize={50}>` and `<ResizablePanel id="editor" defaultSize={75}>`
